title: Masseuse Therapeutica V2 Massage Chair $1999.98 in-store @ Costco (Membership Required)
body:
Deal: Masseuse Therapeutica V2 Massage Chair $1999.98 in-store @ Costco (Membership Required)

[hopper] Nice this has Shiatsu massage. But still above my budget 😭
[ChatGPT-5] Looks like its proper roller-based massage, not just air pressure
[musclmaan] I've never met anyone that buys these, are they worth the price tag?
[Danny117] The only one I’ve ever seen outside a shop or shopping centre is one at my kids day care. In the staff room.
[PurpleMonkeyDwasher] I feel like the parents deserve to use it.
[VCertainty] I had a mate who bought one for around $12,000 or so. Used for a less than a month before going back to hiring massagers for house visits. Just sits in the corner of his office collecting dust.
Price seemed insane but when used it I definitely enjoyed it.
[amibrah] $12,000? Did you mean $1200?! What kind of massage chair costs $12k
[syswong] I was waiting for someone to say this….. I think it is a massage chair but not this model. Yes some goes into 5 figures.
Massage chair is not for everyone especially if you dont need it. it is not those bargain that you will get Yaris at Lexus price. This deal come close but still you wont feel worth it if you dont need it.
I have a five figure one myself, 100% made in Japan with 5 year warranty. My way of looking at it is it cost $8 a day and my family can have a good massage at the comfort of our own home. We use it everyday since day one.
[internet-stranger] They all look like Aussies to me.
As of the 2021 census 2/5 Aussies have a different skin colour. Sorry to break it to you but we are a multiracial country.
[WaterRocket] Pretty unfortunate. Current census will very likely be >50%.
[R3XNebular] Tell me you're racist without telling me you're racist.
[sevendollarsfifty] Nah i'm pretty sure he just told us that he's racist.
[syswong] Good deal except how you going to transport it?
The package size for the Masseuse Massage Terapeutica V2 Massage Chair is approximately 760 mm x 1175 mm x 1160 mm (Width x Height x Depth)
[Nom] You just swing by your local Avis on the way, and book a van for a couple of hours, just like every other none-van-owner does when they need to move something big.
[yummypinacolada] And how are you going to load it to the van? I owned a massage chair, those thing weigh 80-100kg usually
[hashtagbargain] You just swing by your local forklift rental place on the way, and book a forklift for a couple of hours, just like every other none-forklift-owner does when they need to move something big.
[PurpleMonkeyDwasher] @hashtagbargain: How do you move the first forklift? Do you rent a forklift to lift the original forklift? Then maybe a third forklift to clean up after?
[cook99] You buy a single long piece of timber from Bunnings, enjoy 2 hours of courtesy trailer, then take the timber back and say it doesn't suit your needs.
[syswong] How are you lifting the massage on to the tailer?
[cook99] @syswong: Using the the piece of timber as leverage obviously
[syswong] These replies are gold!!
Just shows how stupid some deals are…
I remember case study in my master days. ToysRus 50KG baby gym, end up providing free delivery, dumb ass!
[ozvictor] You can use airmove to pick up and deliver for you at a cost
[Ezuku] They have a delivery service they're affiliated with. Usually store price plus delivery is cheaper than the online cost.
[effraye] $8k on their website, must be trying to offload stock through CostCo
https://masseusemassage.com.au/products/terapeutica-massage-…
[IlIlIl IlI llIIIl] Haha I saw this today. I do want a massage chair but may eventually go for a cheaper $750 one from Amazon
[finnthecheapskate] I want one I just don’t want it in my house.
[Quachii] looks like no one on here has ever bought 1
[jsb] Check out the reviews on the costco link. Only 2 reviews and that too for a Shaving Foam
https://www.costco.com.au/Health-Beauty/Massage-Relaxation/M…
[kohie] I bought the v1 years ago and then had an issue with the foot rollers being too noisy. They replaced the entire chair and gave me a V2 which I've had for a few weeks now. I use it every 2 days and find that it helps with my aches and pains when I tailor the massage through manual modes.
It's not worth it for everyone, but if you have the space and $, it's great for a 20min wind down in the evenings.
FYI - Costco have recommended delivery services for these chairs. I can't remember how much I paid but it wouldn't have been more than $200-$250.
[boomersgold] Thanks for sharing. I plan to demo it in-store but had a question. The website mentions 12 auto modes and shiatsu, rolling, rapping, kneading treatment. What are some of the auto modes you can select from? Does it let us manually choose the massage type? Eg if I wanted a shiatsu massage, can I just select that for 20 minutes?
[syswong] Years? I though it only covers two years warranty?
SL track massage comes in three price range:
Sub 5K, like this one. Quality really soso but ok for occasional use, like yours.
Between 5k to 10K, you get some serious models from the China bunch and the fake Japanese ones. Better quality but not necessary last longer.
10K+ You will find the top China made models and the Real made in Japan ones. I would only buy the Japanese ones at this price with a good warranty, which I did!
